name: p5.js
note: p5 2.x built WITHOUT dom/io/events/accessibility — the modules that assume a page. Drawing, colour, maths, images, text and WEBGL only.

name: q5.js
note: A small p5-compatible sketch library. Ships whole — it is already a classic script and only ~230 KB.

name: three.js
note: 3D, via the WEBGPU build. WebGPURenderer runs on WebGPU where there is one (macOS, Windows) and falls back to WebGL2 where there is not (Linux/WebKitGTK), off ONE code path — so a plugin does not write two renderers. Node materials and TSL come with it, as THREE.TSL, plus the display passes below — including SSGI, which is what a plugin needs for real bounce light. Needs no DOM shim: hand the renderer the canvas amp gives you.
